raw_sections.experience:
CAREER TIMELINE
Mar’13 – Aug’14
Sept’14 – Jul’19 Aug’19 – Feb’21 Feb’21 – Present
Associate Engineer – Big Data – GTI
Senior Engineer – Big Data Engineering
Engineering Manager – Cloud Data Engineering
WORK EXPERIENCE
Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Bengaluru | Engineering Manager – Cloud Data Engineering | Feb’21 – Present Key Result Areas:
Leading a cross-functional project team of over 15 engineers while steering end-to-end design, build, deployment & optimization of cloud-native data solutions across AWS & hybrid infrastructures.
Implementing highly scalable ETL and data ingestion pipelines using Redshift, Glue, Airflow, Azure and Terraform, ensuring robust automation across CI/CD ecosystems.
Governing 1.56 lakh production jobs through Autosys, ensuring seamless orchestration, process
continuity, and adherence to SLA/KPI thresholds.
Managing data warehousing, data lake & lakehouse architectures (Snowflake, Redshift, Delta Lake)
to maximize data accuracy, accessibility & analytical efficiency.
Driving infra provisioning, performance monitoring & resource optimization across S3, EC2, EMR,
IAM, Lambda, Athena, Spark, HDFS & YARN powered ecosystems.
Overseeing hiring, onboarding, capability development, performance appraisals, goal calibration &
mentoring, enhancing unit productivity and role alignment.
Key Highlights:
Built the project from ground zero planning, talent acquisition, development cycles, go-live and
operational support, ensuring zero disruption during transition.
Provided strategic advisory to Service Managers & IT Commercial Leaders, ensuring feasibility and
alignment between SLAs, financial targets & service outcomes.
Consolidating and reviewing KPIs and SLO compliance reports to drive business-aligned service
quality and operational excellence.
Strengthened process resilience using real-time monitoring dashboards (CloudWatch / Grafana),
improving early risk detection and job recovery time.
FIS Global Business Solution, Bengaluru | Senior Engineer – Big Data Engineering Aug’19 – Feb’21 Key Result Areas:
Managed Cloudera-based Hadoop environments & AWS deployments, architecting stable and
scalable big-data ecosystems.
Performed commissioning/decommissioning of nodes, cluster performance tuning, critical alerts
monitoring & backup automation to ensure infra stability.
Administered Hadoop ecosystem components including Hive, Impala, Spark, Sqoop, HBase, Oozie,
Zookeeper & Journal Nodes for reliable end-to-end workload management.
Key Highlights:
Executed CDH upgrades & maintenance ensuring high availability and minimal downtime
throughout the lifecycle.
Leveraged ETL and AWS-driven archival & purge processes to enhance capacity planning and
storage efficiency.
Used R-Studio for operational analytics, strengthening insights on resource consumption & cluster
health.
JP Morgan & Chase Bank, Bengaluru | Associate Engineer – Big Data – GTI Sept’14 – Jul’19 Key Result Areas:
Delivered Hadoop cluster setup, configuration & operational management using Cloudera
distribution, securing uninterrupted data pipeline execution.
Monitored critical job alerts & high availability parameters for 24×7 platform health and workload
stability.
Key Highlights:
Executed CDH upgrades & maintenance cycles, ensuring performance continuity across business
workloads.
Enhanced cluster efficiency through performance tuning of Hadoop jobs, optimizing resource
utilization.
Accenture Services Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru | Linux Administrator | Mar’13 – Aug’14 Key Result Areas:
Managed Linux server administration, infra configuration & system monitoring, supporting smooth
data-center operations.
Key Highlights:
Delivered incident resolution & service continuity, ensuring minimal downtime across critical
enterprise workloads.
HP Service India Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru | Data Center Operator – Linux Admin Oct’11 – Mar’13 Key Result Areas:
Provided data-center support for Linux environments, focusing on scheduled operations, infra
monitoring & ticket management.
Key Highlights:
Executed routine system checks & server performance reviews, maintaining operational consistency
across client environments.
